'''Incom Regional Headquarters''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] and was the regional offices for [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Morna Faenarm]] worked in the Regional Headquarters as an [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]].
